title: aster lateriflorus var. spatelliformis
intro: Aster lateriflorus var. spatelliformis, commonly known as the Side-flowering Aster, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family, characterized by its unique side-facing flowers. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include promoting relaxation, reducing inflammation, and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Aster lateriflorus var. spatelliformis are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, making it useful for anxiety and stress relief. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
